item.title: Study finds obesity top indicator of prediabetes as a third of American children afflicted
item.description: A new study finds that a child's level of excess body fat is a stronger indicator of pre-diabetes or type II diabetes than a child’s diet or activity level.

item.title: Target to remove synthetic colors from cereals by end of May
item.description: Target will only be selling cereals that don’t have synthetic colors by the end of May, the company said Friday.
